title: Morning habits
text: Most people underestimate how much their mornings shape the rest of the day. If you start by checking your phone, you're essentially letting other people set your priorities before you've even had breakfast.

title: Booking a table

title: Climate targets
text: Although the targets were widely welcomed at the time, critics were quick to point out that without binding commitments, they were unlikely to be met. Several years on, it seems those concerns were not entirely unfounded.

title: A job interview
text: What really set her apart from the other candidates was not so much her experience as the way she approached problems. Rather than jumping to conclusions, she asked exactly the kind of questions we'd have hoped for.

title: Urban cycling
text: Had the city invested in proper cycle lanes a decade ago, far fewer people would be driving to work today. Instead, cyclists have to compete for space with buses and delivery vans, which, understandably, puts a lot of people off.

title: Science news
text: The findings, which have yet to be replicated, suggest that the drug may slow the progression of the disease in some patients. However, the researchers were keen to stress that it is far too early to talk about a cure.

title: A travel story
text: No sooner had we checked into the hotel than the power went out across the whole district. We ended up spending the evening on the rooftop with the other guests, which, looking back, was the highlight of the entire trip.

title: Business update
text: Sales in the first quarter fell slightly short of expectations, largely due to supply chain disruptions. That said, we remain confident that the new product line will more than make up for it in the second half of the year.

title: Working with AI
text: It's not that artificial intelligence will necessarily replace us; it's that people who know how to work alongside it will gradually replace those who don't. The real question is how quickly our education systems can adapt.

title: What fluency means
text: If I'm honest, I used to think that fluency meant never making mistakes. What I've come to realise is that it's much more about being able to keep going, rephrasing and recovering, without losing the thread of what you wanted to say.

title: Housing debate
text: It's all very well building more homes, but unless they're genuinely affordable, the people who need them most will still be priced out. What we need isn't just more supply; it's the right kind of supply in the right places.

title: A difficult decision

title: Linking and elision

title: Diagnostic A (reserved)
text: Few people would have predicted that a small family business could grow so quickly. What made the difference, according to its founder, was not a clever strategy but an unusual willingness to listen to its customers.
